title: Player Resize
description: Let your Players easily resize their player model.
body:
**Easily change the Player Models!**

### **Player Commands**
- /plsize <size>
- /plsize reset

### **Admin Commands**
- /plsize reset <player>
- /plsize reload

### **Default Config**
```
min-size: 0.5
max-size: 2.0
cooldown-seconds: 10
```

![Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bb6e9fe1ae6308cbfffcdb9a3b430c4e08b7fac8.png)

### **Permissions**
>   playerresize.use:
`default: true`

>   playerresize.admin:
`default: op`


If there's anything not working, or you would want me to make other versions, let me know in my **[Community Discord](https://discord.gg/xYwZNepebc)**.
**_(Make a ticket for it)_**
